title: An integer multiplicity triple in U whose carrier lies in a compact K ⊆ U is a triple in ℝ^P
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, K ⊆ ℝ^P with K compact and K ⊆ U, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with carrier M ⊆ K. Then there is an integer multiplicity triple R′ in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) with the same carrier, multiplicity and orientation: R′.carrier = M, R′.mult = θ and R′.orient = ξ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → R.carrier ⊆ K → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient
